meta.title: LoadoutLab — CS2 Skin Loadout Builder
meta.description: Personalized CS2 skin loadout recommendations based on your budget, colors and style. Live Skinport prices.

footer.line1: Prototype · ByMykel CS:GO API + Skinport public data

prefs.title: Set Your Preferences
prefs.wearHint: Skins not sold in the selected quality are excluded; prices reflect your selection. Leave empty to use the cheapest quality.
prefs.colorTooltip: Colors match the skin's dominant color. If no exact match exists, a near tone is suggested.
prefs.exactOnlyHint: — no near tones; a slot stays empty if nothing fits
prefs.collectionsHint: Selecting a collection shows every weapon version of that pattern (independent of budget and filters).

warnings.unmatched: 🎨 No matching skin in your color for {count} weapons
warnings.unmatchedHint: Even near tones couldn't be found for these weapons. Increase the budget, add another color or remove them.
warnings.nothingSelected: Select at least one weapon, knife or gloves.

card.nearToneTitle: No exact match in this color — a near-tone skin was selected
card.noColorHint: Your selected color didn't match this weapon.

gallery.emptyColor: No {title} found in your color. Change the color filter.
gallery.showing: Showing {shown} / {total} — pick a model to narrow down.

family.label: Collection
family.hint: All weapons of this pattern — independent of budget and color filters.
